name: Scoped service discovery
audience: Teams unable to agree what a small review should deliver
scope: Bound one proposed assessment before promising implementation

sources.citation: Original Startkompas procedural worksheet: templates/bounded-audit.json, version 1. Guidance only; not independent research or customer evidence.

review.review_route: Repository issue or pull request with a reproducible scope problem and proposed correction. Obtain qualified review before making specialist claims.

templates.name: Bounded audit service
templates.audience: Teams considering a review of one existing workflow
templates.scope: A proposed assessment and prioritised findings, without implementation
unknowns: Whether the customer has this problem and wants an assessment
Whether access and sample quality permit useful conclusions
boundaries: This worksheet is not an audit result or certification
Remediation and regulated assurance require separately agreed scope

sections.prompt: Which team owns the workflow to be reviewed?
Which specific failure or uncertainty would the review investigate?
What decision should the findings help the customer make? Do not promise findings in advance.
Which workflow, sample, access, review method and findings format are in scope?
Which systems, remediation work and assurance claims are excluded?
How does the team currently review this workflow?
Which dated observations support or contradict the need? Do not invent audit results.
How will you check demand, access and scope before offering the review?

checks.prompt: Which single workflow and owner are in scope?
What evidence would show the review is useful rather than merely delivered?
Which remediation and specialist assurance are explicitly excluded?
